verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe an AI Assistant built into the Supabase Dashboard. It generates schema SQL from specifications, diagnoses SQL errors, and gives table-context recommendations. It also offers a real delegation path: users can generate and deploy Edge Functions automatically 'Via AI Assistant'. The MCP and plugin material concerns external agents, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant, evidence that it executes multi-step tasks (e.g., running migrations or changes itself) beyond generating SQL and deploying functions, and depth on permissions and approval for its actions.
